messages:
Maria_CS: quick heads-up — Harbourway needs unblock for week0 cutover: (1) CMK alias + signed cross-account policy, (2) outbound audit delivery to their Splunk HEC. Can we triage? :wave:

Sam_Infra: Ill own egress. Lina, who manages their VPC/CIDR and do you have static egress IPs or a NAT fleet?

Lina_Harbourway: Hey folks, thats our infra team. VPC 10.80.0.0/16. App subnet 10.80.10.0/24, db 10.80.20.0/24. We'll use two NAT GW EIPs: 44.55.66.77 and 44.55.66.78. Target cutover window: Thu 2026-04-09 02:30-04:30 UTC.

Aj_Security: KMS asks: please create a customer-managed CMK with alias alias/redwood/harbourway/prod. No external key material. Add a cross-account key policy granting our control-plane principal. Enable annual rotation after cutover. Also require S3 SSE-KMS on the audit bucket using the same CMK.

Lina_Harbourway: Who needs to sign the key policy on our side? I can loop in Kevin.

Kevin_Ops: Ill review the draft tonight. Post the policy here or DM and Ill ack.

Aj_Security: Minimal IAM role we require in their AWS account: name redwood-harbourway-proxy. Trust policy pointing to our control-plane principal. Permissions: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey* on the CMK. We'll share a role template.

Sam_Infra: For Splunk HEC: TLS to port 8088 + allowlist the two EIPs. If using mTLS, share client cert details. Quick SG snippet to hand to their infra team:

`````terraform
resource "aws_security_group" "rwin_harbourway_egress" {
  name   = "rwin-harbourway-egress"
  vpc_id = "vpc-0example"
  egress {
    from_port   = 8088
    to_port     = 8088
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["44.55.66.77/32","44.55.66.78/32"]
  }
}
`````

Lina_Harbourway: Splunk HEC endpoint: https://ingest.harbourway.corp:8088. We'll enable mTLS and can add EIPs to an allowlist. Our Splunk team needs expected header/token format for the events.

Maria_CS: We'll send the audit ingest JSON schema ahead of the dry-run. Also require CloudTrail multi-region for management events and S3 data events on the logging bucket. Bucket policy must restrict PutObject to their logging principal and enforce SSE-KMS.

Aj_Security: Also request S3 bucket settings: block public access, ACLs disabled, lifecycle > transition to IA at 90d, expire at 365d (compliance may adjust).

deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-7854 created: "Harbourway priv-vpc cutover: CMK policy + Splunk HEC egress + CloudTrail/S3" cc: @Maria_CS @Sam_Infra @Aj_Security

Maria_CS: I'm flagging renewal risk = low for now but with a conditional note: escalate to medium if KMS approval or egress testing slips >5 business days since that delays the billing/commit window. Logging to account health doc.

Sam_Infra: I'll schedule a 30m ops alignment for Mon 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC to walk the playbook: verify CMK alias + signed policy, confirm redwood-harbourway-proxy role, apply SG + test egress dry-run, validate CloudTrail/S3 config. Invite incoming.

Lina_Harbourway: I'll pre-create the CMK draft and a role stub for review, and post the EIP confirmations. Can your team run a small dry-run push (10 events) so our Splunk team can validate schema mapping?

Aj_Security: Yes — we will run a 10-event dry-run during the call and share the JSON schema and sample payload beforehand. Ill also bring the minimal key policy template.

Maria_CS: Post-call action items: 1) signed CMK policy & alias, 2) proxy role present, 3) EIPs confirmed + SG applied, 4) CloudTrail + S3 validated, 5) dry-run successful. Ill log progress on CS-7854 and ping if any item threatens the cutover date. :thumbsup:

Lina_Harbourway: Thanks all  Kevin will review tonight and Ill post the drafts.
